description: scriptconv's Shami backend (Phonemizer.SHAMI), a Levantine-Arabic/English code-switching phonemizer (see scriptconv/phonemizers/shami.py docstring). ``ShamiPhonemizer.get_lang`` only maps to ``["ar", "en"]`` - en-US is a genuine declared use case (bilingual AR/EN front-end) and produced distinct, non-passthrough IPA-ish output: get_ipa('hello','en-US')=='həlˈo͡ʊ' verified on 3 en-US samples; quality vs. the model's intended Levantine-Arabic-flavored English is unverified (no Arabic dataset exists in this arena's g2p league yet).
notes: Verified working for en-US in the shared venv, no extra package required, on 3 samples. pt-PT REMOVED during adversarial review (2026-08-13): ShamiPhonemizer.get_lang() only supports ["ar","en"] - there is no Portuguese variety anywhere in this engine. The original PR's pt-PT probe (get_ipa('mundo','pt-PT')=='mˈʌndo͡ʊ') was not a language match, it was the frontend's script-based (Arabic-vs-Latin) routing silently reading Portuguese-orthography Latin text as English-flavored input regardless of the declared lang tag - a bogus lang claim, not a working pt-PT fighter.
